title: pseudolysimachion ovatum subsp. kiusianum
intro: Pseudolysimachion ovatum subsp. kiusianum, commonly known as the Kyushu false loosestrife, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including relieving fever, colds, and other respiratory issues due to its health benefits of being antibacterial and anti-inflammatory. The therapeutic actions of Pseudolysimachion ovatum subsp. kiusianum include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, helping to alleviate symptoms of coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
